sam_sales: FYI - AtlasBank wants an on‑prem POC but will only accept physical delivery (USB/DVD). They asked for a clear upgrade/rollback playbook, signed bundles, SBOM privacy options (redaction for export controls), and how licensing & metering work offline. Can SE/Infra/Legal advise? cc @kai_se @ana_infra

kai_se: Short list of questions for scoping:
- k8s operator or systemd/VMs?
- Do they want us to sign artifacts or to generate sign-ready manifests for them to sign?
- Is telemetry strictly forbidden, or can logs be written locally for support pull?

sam_sales: They run k8s for ML infra + a few hardened VMs. Telemetry = no egress; local logs ok if opt-in. Preferred: customer signs with their CA if possible.

ana_infra: Plan: produce two bundle formats (operator-bundle, flat-vm-bundle). Core bundle contents:
- manifest.json (version, digests)
- images/ (OCI tarballs)
- checksums.txt (SHA256)
- sbom.cdx.json (CycloneDX)
- bundle.sig (detached ED25519 by default)
- verify_offline.sh (bash verifier)
- license.json (timeboxed POC token)
We can also produce an "unsigned-for-customer-sign" artifact set: manifest + instructions + verification helper.

mike_sec: Security preferences:
- If customer signs themselves, require them to use HSM-backed key locally and provide cert chain detail in onboarding doc.
- Offer an attestation option: our ops signs with HSM and we provide HSM attestation. That has different liability implications.
- SBOM: offer two flavors: full SBOM or redacted SBOM (strip certain PURLs/urls for export control). Document exactly what is redacted.

kai_se: Upgrade/patch cadence options to present:
A) Quarterly feature/security bundle (base)
B) Monthly vetted hotfixes (+ packaging/QA)
C) Emergency rapid patch (expedited packaging + signing, SLA e.g., 4h or 24h depending on contract)
Pricing delta guidance: monthly channel ~ +12% relative to quarterly-only; emergency SLA add-on ~ +8-12% on top. Final numbers from finance.

ana_infra: Offline hotfix flow idea:
- Customer files a signed request or provides checksum of affected file
- We produce a minimal signed patch bundle (delta tar) with checksums and signature
- Customer verifies with verify_offline.sh, applies with patch_apply.sh which pins manifests and records attestation.json
Rollback: include previous manifest and a rollback.sh that re-applies prior image digests.

mike_sec: Verification must exit non-zero on tamper. Include reproducible verification steps and a small Go tool for deterministic hashing (no libc dependencies).

frank_legal: Commercial/legal notes:
- If customer holds signing keys, we'll ask for a narrow addendum documenting roles for signing, incident support, and forensic access.
- Redacting SBOM entries for export control requires signoff from legal/compliance; it may affect vulnerability triage.
- Metering disabled or masked is a commercial exception and will impact pricing. We'll need a signed acceptance of reduced telemetry for liability reasons.

artifact-bot: playbook-created: /playbooks/airgap-physical-delivery-checklist.md assigned to ana_infra, kai_se, mike_sec. Due: 2026-04-08 :spiral_calendar:

sam_sales: Next steps: ana to drop sample operator-bundle + unsigned manifest set to staging for ops demo (sideload link). kai to draft the two pricing bands and emergency SLA options. frank to prepare a one-pager addendum for customer-signing vs vendor-signing tradeoffs. We'll run a technical call next Tue. Thanks all :thumbsup:
